Classification.description:
Which of the team's document types a file is (c-249): the model's choice and how sure it is, or none.
`needsReview` when none fits or the confidence is under the floor.
Classification.title: Classification

DocumentTypeExample.description:
A correction a person made on a read of the type, which later reads of it are given (c-297). `line` is where the
value was printed, masked as the team masks personal data; `record` is the record's position, for several.
DocumentTypeExample.title: DocumentTypeExample

DocumentTypeIn.description: A new document type and its version 1. `id` is the caller's (lowercase, e.g. levy_notice) or generated.

fields.description: Each field: key, label, type (text, number, money, date, enum), required, description, options (enum), reviewBelow, alwaysReview, keyField (a key field: a review shows it first and requires it checked), and its rules: pattern, emptyWhen, clean.
fields.title: Fields

DocumentTypeIn.title: DocumentTypeIn

fields.description: Each field: key, label, type (text, number, money, date, enum), required, description, options (enum), reviewBelow, alwaysReview, keyField (a key field: a review shows it first and requires it checked), and its rules: pattern, emptyWhen, clean.
fields.title: Fields

Extraction.description: An extraction's state, and its scored answer once done: what the Extract from file step's outputs carry.
Extraction.title: Extraction

ExtractionRequest.description:
`fields` follow the Extract from file step's schema (key, label, type, required, description, enum,
reviewBelow, alwaysReview); `many` answers one record per thing the document names (c-235).
ExtractionRequest.title: ExtractionRequest

Layout.description: A file's layout (c-247): pages, blocks in reading order with their table cells, and words.
Layout.title: Layout

Purged.description: What was removed for a deleted file: its extractions (with their corrections) and the samples naming it.
Purged.title: Purged

TemplateOffer.description: Checked model reads of the type that share one layout no current template reads (c-254).
TemplateOffer.title: TemplateOffer

TemplateSuggestIn.description: The team's finished reads of the type a suggestion is drawn from (c-254).
TemplateSuggestIn.title: TemplateSuggestIn

TemplateSuggestion.description:
A draft template, saved by nobody until a builder posts it as a new version, and how it reads each read it came
from: matched or the anchors it missed, and per field the read's value against the template's.
TemplateSuggestion.title: TemplateSuggestion

TestEstimate.description:
What testing a version spends, before it runs (c-236): priced at the type's measured tokens per call, the
tenant's when the type has none yet, else a fixed guess (c-247); `basis` says which.
TestEstimate.title: TestEstimate

Removes what the token's team derived from a deleted file: its extractions with their corrections, and the
samples naming it. A workflow on the file-deleted trigger calls this; files-service never does. A file
files-service still serves the team is refused (409), so a purge can never remove the reads of a live file.
